artists.biography: Yusuf Islam, commonly known by his stage names Cat Stevens or Yusuf/Cat Stevens, is a British singer-songwriter and musician. He has sold more than 100 million records and has more than two billion streams. His musical career has explored folk, rock, pop, and, later in his career, Islamic music. Following two decades in which he performed only music which met strict religious standards, he returned to making secular music in 2006. He was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2014. He has received two honorary doctorates and awards for promoting peace as well as other humanitarian awards.

Collected" by Cat Stevens is a comprehensive compilation album originally released in 2007, showcasing the breadth of his influential career in rock and pop music. Spanning his early hits from the late 1960s through his most celebrated works of the 1970s, the album features key tracks such as "Wild World," "Father and Son," "Moonshadow," and "Peace Train." Musically, "Collected" highlights Stevens' signature blend of acoustic-driven melodies, introspective lyrics, and gentle vocal delivery, which helped define the singer-songwriter movement of the era.

As a career-spanning retrospective, "Collected" holds a significant place in Cat Stevens' discography, offering both longtime fans and new listeners an accessible entry point to his enduring catalog. Released by Universal Music and later reissued by Music On Vinyl, the album was well-received for its thoughtful track selection and high-quality presentation. While not a chart-topping release, "Collected" has been praised for its ability to capture the emotional depth and musical evolution that have made Cat Stevens one of the most respected figures in rock and pop history.
